task: N2.9 bounded consumer-condition extraction and independent finite behavior validation
registration: Known N2.8 errors and old Linux D05/D10 source shapes were inspected. This protocol fixes the development scope before method freeze, hidden challenge disclosure and actual extraction/evaluation outcomes. This is not a new Linux holdout.
purpose: Move beyond citation/order checks by extracting restricted public-consumer branch conditions and distinguishing a search witness from per-iteration checks after updates; preserve unsupported paths and conditional applicability.

scope.frontend: Reuse installed pycparser for complete ordinary C only; do not modify old source_conditions, lexical checker or finite_set_effects, and do not delete GNU/asm/macros from real source to obtain a parse.
scope.data: Scalar integer parameters and locals; fixed-size local one-dimensional arrays; legal indices, initialized values and safe bounded arithmetic are explicit conditional inputs, not automatically proved C memory safety. No pointers, addresses, globals, unknown calls or alias effects.
scope.loops: Canonical for from index=0, index<an initialized immutable local constant or literal in 0..16, step increment. Preserve optional pure skip/continue guards, search predicate assignment+break, no-witness failure return, optional singleton/other early returns and later conditional update/check phase. Different identifiers must not change conclusions.
scope.output: Source/hash/coordinates, branch domains, guards, reads/writes, early/failure exits, search witness condition and per-reached-iteration check with phase; never equate pre-state forall with an update-then-check relation. Existence requires matching assignment, early exit and no-witness failure guard; mere break is insufficient. Any unsupported reassignment/control/effect preserves insufficiency. Per-member quantification covers only members actually reaching that check; empty coverage is explicitly vacuous and cannot establish a valid architecture state. Unknown effects/unsupported control remain insufficient and are not deleted.
scope.condition_evaluation: Safe finite evaluation from extracted restricted IR and explicit inputs; no arbitrary eval or manually supplied expected quantifier. Legal input checks and unknowns are visible. This is not an arbitrary C interpreter, full weakest-precondition solver or normative architecture specification.
scope.initial_linux_replay: Only unchanged existing N2.5 D05/D10 complete configured instrumented regions, which contain GNU expressions/asm. Unsupported is a valid result. Do not substitute a hand-rewritten toy or source projection while claiming original Linux success.

roles.implementation: n2_selector: module and small development cases/tests; no hidden oracle sources/results before freeze
roles.behavior_oracle: arch_check_review: separate human-authored ordinary-C finite source and independently written sequential Python reference; no extractor implementation/output reading before expected results freeze
roles.audit: authority_audit: scope, fail-closed branches, quantifiers and contribution attribution
roles.root: Freeze/check identities, execute method against frozen oracle challenge, interpret limits, update daily log and Windows/WSL notes

evaluation.development: Ordinary C supported/unsupported shapes and targeted method tests; all are component development, not kernel defects.
evaluation.challenge: After implementation freeze, disclose fixed independent ordinary-C sources and finite inputs. Primary N=3: masks, targets, relation assignments and traversal permutations; report executions and unique actual inputs separately. Include empty/singleton-self/singleton-other/no-witness/partial-witness/bad-post-update/order cases, alpha renaming and unsupported lookalikes.
evaluation.finite_domain: N=3 is the three-element object/member domain, not three Linux cases or three source samples. There are eight masks, three targets, 3^3 initial relation maps and six traversal permutations before deduplicating filtered member orders. Source variants, total executions and unique effective inputs are separate units.
evaluation.reference: Compare independent native GCC execution return status with independent Python sequential behavior. Then compare extracted-IR decisions/phase evidence with that frozen reference, not with implementation-produced expectations.
evaluation.negative_controls: Source with incompatible control/effects or missing prerequisites remains insufficient, not silently skipped or assigned a true condition.
evaluation.freeze: Freeze module and developer tests before hidden challenge disclosure; all source/expected records kept. No fixes after seeing challenge results to chase a pass. Freeze scope amendments before actual outcomes and disclose them.
evaluation.claims: No accuracy/generalization/kernel-case count from finite inputs. No hardcoded architecture/rq/function names. If raw Linux remains unsupported, state that automated real-source obligations are still not established.

native_C_builds: Allowed solely for the independent finite toy oracle; record compiler and source identities, not kernel validation.
exit: Complete implementation, independent finite validation, unchanged Linux replay, scope audit and notes as one bounded batch. Explicit unknown/failure remains useful; do not broaden syntax or fetch helpers to manufacture success.
